description.value: Bisou Bakehouse is a French-inspired bakery and café in Vancouver's West End, nestled near English Bay, offering handcrafted pastries including buttery croissants, signature 30-day fermented sourdough, baguettes, and cakes baked fresh daily with no preservatives. Founded in 2006, the bakehouse has grown to supply luxury Vancouver hotels including Fairmont properties and airlines through DNATA. A second location operates in North Vancouver, and the café also offers sandwiches, beverages, catering, and wholesale services.
